%%pyspark
#df = spark.read.json('abfss://spark-training@youngwon2.dfs.core.windows.net/exercise/SampleNested.json')
## If header exists uncomment line below
##, header=True

from pyspark.sql.types import *
# Define the schema
schema = StructType([
    StructField("customer_id", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("name", StringType(), True),
    StructField("email", StringType(), True),
    StructField("country", StringType(), True),
    StructField("customer_type", StringType(), True),
    StructField("registration_date", DateType(), True),
    StructField("age", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("gender", StringType(), True),
    StructField("total_purchases", IntegerType(), True),
    StructField("ingestion_timestamp", TimestampType(), True)
])

df2 = spark.read.csv("abfss://spark-training@youngwon2.dfs.core.windows.net/exercise/customer.csv", header=True, schema=schema)

df3 = df2.filter("customer_type == 'VIP'")
df4 = df2.filter("customer_type == 'Regular'")
df5 = df3.union(df4)
df6 = df3.union(df4).union(df2)
df7 = df6.distinct()
display(df7)

# dropping all the rows with any null value in it
# df3 = df2.dropna()
from pyspark.sql.functions import col
df4 = df2.filter(col("email").isNull())
display(df4)

from pyspark.sql.functions import desc

df3 = df2.orderBy(desc("age"))
display(df3)

# same as orderBy
df3 = df2.sort("age")
df4 = df2.sort(desc("age"), "gender")

from pyspark.sql.functions import sum, avg, max, min

df3 = df2.groupBy("gender").sum("age")

df3 = df2.groupBy("gender").max("age")
df3 = df2.groupBy("gender").min("age")
df3 = df2.groupBy("gender").avg("age")
df4 = df2.groupBy("gender").agg(sum("age"), max("age"), min("age"), avg("age"))
df5 = df2.groupBy("gender").agg(sum("age").alias("total age"), max("age").alias("max age"), min("age").alias("min age"), avg("age").alias("average age"))
display(df5)

from pyspark.sql.functions import upper, lower, ltrim, rtrim, trim, regexp_replace, split, length, concat_ws
df3 = df2.select(upper("country"))
df4 = df2.select(lower("country"))
df5 = df2.select(ltrim("country"), rtrim("country"), trim("country"))
df6 = df2.select(ltrim("country").alias("left trim"), rtrim("country").alias("right trim"), trim("country").alias("trim"))
df7 = df2.select(regexp_replace(col("country"), "Unknown", "Not Sure"))
df8 = df2.select("email", split("email", "@"))
df9 = df2.select("email", col("email").contains("customer"))
df10 = df2.select("email", length("email"))
df11 = df2.select(concat_ws("@@", "age", "country"))
display(df11)

from pyspark.sql.functions import *

# df3 = df2.select("registration_date", year("registration_date"), month("registration_date"), dayofmonth("registration_date"))
# df4 = df2.select("registration_date", dayofweek("registration_date"), weekofyear("registration_date"), dayofyear("registration_date"), quarter("registration_date"))
# df4 = df2.select("registration_date", date_add("registration_date", 10), date_sub("registration_date", 10) )
# df4 = df2.select("registration_date", date_format("registration_date", "MMMM dd, yyyy"))
df4 = df2.select(current_date()).limit(1)

display(df4)

# df4 = df2.select("ingestion_timestamp", year("ingestion_timestamp"), month("ingestion_timestamp"), dayofmonth("ingestion_timestamp"), hour("ingestion_timestamp"), minute("ingestion_timestamp"), second("ingestion_timestamp"))
# df4 = df2.select(current_timestamp())
df4 = df2.select("ingestion_timestamp", datediff(current_timestamp(), "ingestion_timestamp"))

display(df4)

# write out put overwrite or append mode by overwrite folder or add in a new item in existing folder
df4.write.mode("overwrite").json('abfss://spark-training@youngwon2.dfs.core.windows.net/exercise/output/')
# if there is something in the folder, it will ignore
# f4.write.mode("ignore").json('abfss://spark-training@youngwon2.dfs.core.windows.net/exercise/output/')
f4.write.mode("error").json('abfss://spark-training@youngwon2.dfs.core.windows.net/exercise/output/')
f4.write.mode("error").option("header", "True").partitionBy("customer_type").cvs('abfss://spark-training@youngwon2.dfs.core.windows.net/exercise/output/cvs_partition/')
